statements.t: Keyser’s last day of work as our Interim President and Chief Executive Officer will be October 31, 2026, he will resign from all officer and director positions with us and our subsidiaries and affiliates effective November 1, 2026, and he will continue as a full-time employee in the role of Special Advisor through December 31, 2026 to support the Company and the Chief Executive Officer leadership transition.
Kvarda’s services will be provided pursuant to an engagement letter between the Company and A&M.
On June 17, 2026, we announced organizational changes intended to accelerate our transformation initiatives, strengthen customer focus and create a more agile and efficient operating model.
We may be unable to replace the revenue that was expected under this contract on a timely basis or at all.

In addition, our future capital expenditures and other cash requirements could be higher than currently expected due to various factors, including any expansion of our business or strategic acquisitions.
We have the ability to borrow under our Amended Revolver to meet expected obligations as they come due.
We expect to make payments of approximately $5.4 million per year for the next seven years and approximately $1.0 million in the final year.

Based on year-to-date 2026 results and our outlook for the fourth quarter, we are reaffirming 2026 full year guidance for all financial measures, provided in our second quarter earnings announcement, dated August 5, 2026.

• Change in working capital (change in operating assets and liabilities) is expected to result in a use of cash of approximately $40 million for 2026 primarily related to both our RAC contract renewals and the timing of expenditures and collections of our ongoing installation work in New York City
The Company expects to resume its customary quarterly earnings conference calls beginning with its fourth quarter and full-year 2026 results.
Understanding the information contained in these filings is important in order to fully understand our reported financial results and our business outlook for future periods.

We intend to use our website including our quarterly earnings presentation as a means of disclosing material non-public information, additional financial and operating metrics and for complying with disclosure obligations under Regulation FD.
